person.name: Petra Fölk
person.summary: Product designer (UX/UI) based in Berlin, designing products and visuals since 2008. Lead designer of ShareTheMeal by the UN World Food Programme, product designer at nebenan.de, and designer for N26, Verimi, Amorelie and Gitti.

experience.highlights: Donation revenue, registration and onboarding, marketplace monetization for Germany’s leading neighborhood platform.
Product detail pages and cart drawer redesign to lift webshop conversion.
Webshop optimization, user research, Advent Calendar landing pages (B2C & B2B).
Secure login, two-factor authentication, digital ID wallet integrations.
Scaled the donation app globally: flows, onboarding, campaigns, community features, brand and UI.
First transparent N26 Mastercard, card carriers, branded goods, design sprint with cross-functional team.

publicCaseStudies.title: Amorelie webshop & landing pages
publicCaseStudies.description: Product design for Amorelie: webshop optimization, user research, and the redesign of the annual Advent Calendar landing pages.

publicCaseStudies.title: Gitti product detail pages
publicCaseStudies.description: Redesign of the product detail pages and cart drawer for Gitti, a conscious beauty brand from Berlin, to lift webshop conversion.

publicCaseStudies.title: N26 transparent Mastercard
publicCaseStudies.description: Brand and UI design for N26: the first transparent N26 Mastercard, its card carriers and branded goods, explored in a design sprint.

publicCaseStudies.title: ShareTheMeal donation app
publicCaseStudies.description: Lead product design for ShareTheMeal, the UN World Food Programme's donation app (2016–2019): donation flows, onboarding, campaign discovery and community features.

publicCaseStudies.title: ShareTheMeal brand & animations
publicCaseStudies.description: Brand and UI work for ShareTheMeal by the UN World Food Programme: app UI assets, iconography, illustrations, animations and a design system.

publicCaseStudies.title: Verimi 2FA & digital identity
publicCaseStudies.description: Designing trust at Verimi: simpler two-factor authentication and secure login for a digital ID wallet used across third-party services.

notes: Three nebenan.de deep-dive case studies (donation, registration, marketplace) are password-protected; contact via LinkedIn.
